environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No WAF, no CDN, no CSP headers configured. Service runs as a systemd unit with default permissions. Session cookies use SameSite=None for cross-origin API consumers. No Content-Security-Policy response header is set anywhere in the middleware chain.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no HTTP inspection)
